purpose: Teach: こもり/思いがけない/片づけ/寝かせ/横顔/思い当たる/ホタル/育た

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋にこもりすぎないでね
lines.en: Sho, try not to spend all your time holed up in your room, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, warm reminder. Soft opening on his name. The tone of someone who's noticed but isn't worried—just checking in. No pressure underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんから思いがけないプレゼントもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad gave me the most amazing surprise gift!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick intake of breath before the rush of words. The kind of joy that can't quite contain itself. Eyes wide.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の片づけ、お願いね
lines.en: Sho, I need you to tidy up your room for me, sweetheart.
lines.style: Practical but warm. The word 'need' carries gentle weight—not demanding, but clear. Ends with softness on the endearment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんがぼくを寝かせてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma tucked me in tonight.
lines.style: Quiet, content. The small detail offered like something precious. A note of safety and ease in his voice. Settling into the memory as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの横顔、立派ね
lines.en: Sho, your father has such a dignified profile.
lines.style: Soft, observant. Speaking almost to herself—noticing something about him in that moment. Warm and a little distant, the way you sound thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、思い当たる節があるよ
lines.en: Mom, I think I understand something now.
lines.style: Hesitant but thoughtful. A child working through something real. The words come slowly, like he's finding them as he speaks. Careful, sincere.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭にホタルが来てたわよ
lines.en: Sho, there were fireflies in the garden tonight!
lines.style: Warm, animated. A moment of delight shared. The kind of tone you use when you want someone to look up and see what you saw. Open and inviting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 野菜は太陽が当たれば、よく育たない子も育つよ。ママ、ぼくが育てたお花、大きく育ったよ
lines.en: Mom, even plants that don't get much sun can still grow strong with enough light—and look! The flowers I grew got so big!
lines.style: Quiet certainty underneath gentle excitement. The words build—starts observant, then brightens with pride at the end. A child sharing something he's learned and built.
